title: Forgetting under noise is undecidable
description: A natural noisy Wang rule on Z^4 is ergodic exactly when its finite raw tile set does not tile the plane. A cardinal checker and a fixed 512-of-768 quorum use the tiles themselves and one blank. A transverse-quorum lift of Kari's nilpotency reduction gives the same equivalence on Z^3 for north/east deterministic tile sets. At every 0 < epsilon <= 382205952^(-33720), non-tiling inputs in either family have all-input nonconstancy probability on a finite window F at most |F| C_R exp(-t/4), with universal exponent and an effectively findable input-dependent prefactor uniform in epsilon. Their normalized space-time interactions on Z^5 and Z^4, respectively, have exactly one Gibbs measure, with no invariance assumed, and exponential weak spatial mixing in arbitrary finite volumes. Tiling gives two invariant laws and at least two fully translation-invariant Gibbs measures; a one-tile example shows why the rate requires non-tiling. Ergodicity, Gibbs uniqueness and exponential weak spatial mixing are undecidable at one fixed rational rate in both families. A saturation theorem explains the earlier budget-only dimension obstruction. The retained Z^6 natural rule also has robustness. Its Theorems D and A and the qualitative Z^4 classification (Theorem E) are verified in Lean. The Z^3 classification, the lower-dimensional rates and the new Gibbs corollary are not formalized. The inspector theory and Z^8 machine-family Lean core are retained.
notes: Preprint. It has not been peer reviewed. Version 2.2.0 updates version 2.1.0 (10.5281/zenodo.24178276). New: Corollary 12.14, exactly one Gibbs measure and exponential weak spatial mixing for the non-tiling inputs of the Z^4 natural rule and of the Z^3 family (space-time interactions on Z^5 and Z^4), at least two translation-invariant Gibbs measures for tiling inputs, and undecidability of Gibbs uniqueness at one fixed rate; and a new Lean core (lean-lower/) for Theorem E, the Z^4 classification, with its two undecidability corollaries. All three Lean folders build from a fresh clone with lake exe cache get and lake build. No existing statement or number changes. Text: CC BY 4.0. Scripts and Lean sources: MIT or Apache 2.0.
